body: Wire server/guild Registry into apps2/mud. Players can found linkshells (ls-create), forge Feathers to invite (ls-invite), leave (ls-leave), and inspect rosters (ls-info). Guild chat gated via CanChat(). GuildID synced into chat.Session for guild chat routing.
title: S92-03: MUD linkshell guild system — server/guild Registry, ls-create/invite/leave/info commands
